def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(sum(grid,[])).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # connected components non-bg
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg}
    comps=[]
    while pts:
        todo=[pts.pop()]; comp=[]
        while todo:
            r,c=todo.pop();comp.append((r,c))
            for q in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]:
                if q in pts:pts.remove(q);todo.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    masks=[]
    for comp in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in comp];cs=[c for r,c in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        mask=[[int(grid[r][c]!=bg) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        mh,mw=len(mask),len(mask[0])
        if all(sum(row)>0 for row in mask) and all(any(mask[r][c] for r in range(mh)) for c in range(mw)):
            masks.append((mask,comp))
    mask,comp=max(masks,key=lambda z:sum(map(sum,z[0])))
    mh,mw=len(mask),len(mask[0])
    return [[grid[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]] if mask[r%mh][c%mw] else bg for c in range(mh*mw)] for r in range(mh*mw)]

def transform(grid):

    comps=[]
    while pts:
        todo=[pts.pop()]; comp=[]
        while todo:
            r,c=todo.pop();comp.append((r,c))
            for q in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]:
                if q in pts:pts.remove(q);todo.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    stamp_comp=next(comp for comp in comps if len({grid[r][c] for r,c in comp})>1)

    rs=[r for r,c in mask_comp];cs=[c for r,c in mask_comp]

    mask=[[int(grid[r][c]!=bg) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    rs=[r for r,c in stamp_comp];cs=[c for r,c in stamp_comp]

    stamp=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    mh,mw=len(mask),len(mask[0]); sh,sw=len(stamp),len(stamp[0])
